initial_visual_issues.description: Shadow-fonts and Curves-Regular weakened readability/acting in the Darius threat, mythic narration and final cosmic-revelation passages.
initial_visual_issues.repair: Restore the approved Mac-dinh font families for those roles while keeping Granite, Manga-fonts and Skill-fonts-1 where the panel emotion supports them.

initial_visual_issues.description: The renderer used bbox[2] as line width, so custom fonts with non-zero left bearing could occasionally look pushed to one side despite center alignment.
initial_visual_issues.repair: Center visible ink using bbox width x2-x1 and compensate left bearing; add a regression test using repository manga fonts.

initial_visual_issues.description: The panic bubble retained two English fragments, 'I' and 'IT!', outside the detector-owned cleaned text region.
initial_visual_issues.repair: Apply a local white-bubble cleanup to only those two interior source-text fragments, verify zero dark source pixels, then rerender.

initial_visual_issues.description: A small subset of localized text blocks technically fit but occupied nearly the full detector-owned source-text width, making them feel visually squeezed even while centered.
initial_visual_issues.repair: Apply symmetric horizontal insets to 13 reviewed objects, preserve their center, and refit fixed typography without changing semantic font roles.
